definitions.explanation: A small, private funeral attended only by the family and a few close friends, without inviting colleagues, neighbors and acquaintances. It has become common in Japan since the 2000s.

examples.japanese: ⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{家族葬|かぞくそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: We held the funeral as a family-only service.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{家族葬|かぞくそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{望|のぞ}んでいた→望む：01976_nozomu⟧。
examples.english: My father wanted a small family funeral.

examples.japanese: ⟦{故人|こじん}→故人：02807_kojin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{遺志|いし}→遺志：31143_ishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{近親者|きんしんしゃ}のみ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{家族葬|かぞくそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{済|す}ませました→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: In accordance with the deceased's wishes, the funeral was held privately with close relatives only.

notes:
Death notices often say the funeral was held as a {家族葬|かぞくそう}; whether condolence money or flowers are declined is usually stated separately.
